messages:
maya: FYI I opened a small docs PR to spell out how adapter-tagged variants interact with runtime fallbacks and routing. PR: https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/4132 :eyes:
ravi: cool — is this mostly copy edits or are there config snippets too?
maya: both. short explainer + two SDK snippets (JS + Python), an example route JSON, and a short QA checklist. primary goal: make it obvious how `fallback_policy` is interpreted (exact variant order) and what to expect in terms of context window changes when adapters are present.
tanya: nice. can you call out that fallback order is evaluated left-to-right and the runtime picks the first compatible variant? we get confusion when people expect it to pick the numerically closest quantization.
maya: added explicit line: "fallback_policy is a left-to-right preference list; runtime picks the first compatible variant available in the selected capacity tier." also added an example showing intent vs behavior.
olivia: please include a note about on-prem/private runtimes: older private agents (< v1.8.0) treat adapter variants as incompatible and will skip to base variant, so document needs a compatibility table.
maya: done. I added a compatibility matrix with runtime versions and known behavior.
ravi: can we include a tiny JS SDK example showing explicit fallback policy and quality monitoring flags? that helps users copy/paste.
maya: added JS snippet: ```js
// SDK snippet: prefer int8 fallback then base
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'nebula3b+adapter:romulan-v1',
  fallback_policy: ['nebula3b-int8', 'nebula3b'],
  route_options: { quality_monitoring: true, max_total_tokens: 4096 }
});
console.log(resp.output_text);
```
tanya: great. QA wants a short eval set of 4 prompts (not 3) and a one-liner script for smoke tests that fails the CI if perplexity diverges > 5% on baseline. can you add that to examples/adapter-regression-set.md?
maya: added 4 prompts: long-summarize (6-paragraph), translate marketing headline, multi-turn contact extraction, and a factual-recall from an earlier message. also included a tiny Node script to run `rwctl` and compute a basic BLEU-ish score.
qa-bot: automated smoke-run: ran regression set against nebula3b-int8 fallback locally — pass (mean delta 3.2%). Details: https://ci.company/qa-runs/9821

olivia: editorial nit: change "will preserve semantics" to "aims to preserve intent" — less strong. also tighten language around changes in tokenization.
maya: updated wording. swapped phrasing in both the model card blurb and the catalog note.
ravi: one more ask: add CLI examples for quick local verification (rwctl infer ...). Folks on infra-only machines skip SDKs.
maya: added two CLI examples (one forcing prefer-quant via flag and one showing explicit route JSON upload).
docs-ci-bot: PR 4132 docs build: success 
Preview: https://docs-preview.company/4132

maya: last step: can QE confirm the regression run in the PR? once QA-bot posts green, I'll merge. tagging @qa-team for a quick smoke.
qa-bot: I already ran a local smoke, leaving a note in PR and linking results. If QE wants a full cluster run, ping me and I'll enqueue.
tanya: thanks all. this should reduce support tickets where customers see weird truncation with adapters.
maya: merging after QE signoff. I'll also add a line to release notes about adapter fallbacks and private runtime caveat. :shipit:
